ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 0.65 high-intensity (white) to 0.35 low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones occupying the central 70% of each lobe. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the trailing edge and converges at the median notch. A distinct, high-contrast vertical black linear feature is positioned in the mid-right lobe (approx. x=0.75 relative width). Dark mottling clusters are visible on the inner portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees forming a deep V-shaped depression; apex is sharply defined at the junction of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels). Distal tips exhibit extreme topographic irregularity due to clustered biological growth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a broad convex sweep from the notch towards the distal tips, ending in tapered, jagged points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured pixel clusters located on both the left and right distal tips, indicating barnacle colonization. Numerous small, low-intensity circular spots (mottling) are distributed across the white ventral regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, near-vertical low-intensity linear feature (rake mark or scratch) on the right lobe. Several smaller, faint horizontal linear pixel disruptions on the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical linear scar on the right lobe; prominent barnacle encrustations on both fluke tips; presence of a yellowish-green linear object (seaweed or rope) trailing from the right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of the heavy barnacle accumulation on the tips and the singular, high-contrast vertical scar on the right lobe creates a highly unique pixel signature.
